subject: Summer 2027 Research Internship — Process Systems Engineering & Dynamic Modeling | IIT Delhi
body_text:
Dear Professor Young,

My name is Harshith N, an undergraduate in Chemical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi). I am writing to express my strong interest in joining your group at the Industrial Information and Control Centre for a Summer 2027 visiting research internship.

I have read your research on dynamic process simulation, digital twins, and systems optimization for chemical processing operations. Your work coupling physical transport models with real-time operational constraints for industrial systems is directly relevant to my technical goals.

In my project, Neural Process Twin, I developed deep learning surrogate models in PyTorch for 2D steady-state heat conduction, evaluating surrogate prediction accuracy against numerical finite difference solutions. Combining this scientific computing foundation with coursework in process dynamics, I am eager to assist with dynamic modeling and simulation tooling for your group's initiatives.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your process simulation projects for 10–12 weeks in Summer 2027. My CV and research interests statement are attached for your consideration, and I would be grateful for the chance to discuss potential alignment.

Sincerely,
Harshith N
Undergraduate, Department of Chemical Engineering
Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
ch1251635@iitd.ac.in

grounding_evidence.research_overlap: Dynamic process simulation, digital twins, and chemical engineering systems optimization.
grounding_evidence.potential_contribution: Assisting with dynamic modeling modules and PyTorch-based process simulation tooling.

subject: Summer 2027 Research Internship — Reduced Basis Methods & PDE Surrogates | IIT Delhi

Dear Professor Patera,

My name is Harshith N, an undergraduate student in Chemical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi). I am writing to inquire about a visiting research internship in your laboratory for 10–12 weeks in Summer 2027.

subject: Summer 2027 Research Internship — Autonomous Mobile Robotics & Perception | IIT Delhi

subject: Summer 2027 Research Internship — High-Performance Parallel Computing & Systems | IIT Delhi
body_text:
Dear Professor Leiserson,

My name is Harshith N, an undergraduate at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi). I am writing to express my strong interest in a visiting undergraduate research internship with your Supertech research group at MIT CSAIL for Summer 2027.

I have studied your group's research in multithreaded runtime systems, cache-oblivious algorithms, and software performance engineering. Your analytical methodology for diagnosing memory locality and work-span scalability provides a rigorous foundation for parallel computing systems.

In my project, the LLM Inference Intelligence Engine, I built empirical benchmarking scripts instrumenting prefill and token generation phases across CPU/GPU architectures, applying Roofline analysis to identify memory-bandwidth saturation versus compute bounds. I am eager to apply this empirical profiling experience to your parallel systems projects.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to Supertech's performance engineering research for 10–12 weeks in Summer 2027. My CV and research interests are attached, and I would be grateful for the chance to discuss potential alignment over a brief call.

Sincerely,
Harshith N
